scope: Inspect only the official train shard and metadata. Audit the Llama-2-7b-chat-hf response subset, source/question grouping, span integrity, and CPU tokenizer compatibility with stride-1 4-raw-BPE windows.
label_policy: Use only released valid=true end-exclusive character spans whose text exactly matches response[start:end]. Preserve automatic-label status; do not repair, expand, or infer missing labels.
group_policy: Within train, group transitively by identical official question index, normalized question, source-article identity, or exact retrieved context. Cross-split isolation remains unverified because test rows stay sealed.
window_policy: Use the local Llama-2-7b-chat-hf fast tokenizer over exact released full_prompt + one space + exact answer, no added special tokens or truncation. Map end-exclusive spans by alphanumeric-character overlap. Form stride-1 windows of 4 raw answer BPE tokens; all-punctuation windows are not lexically evaluable.
